name: Andrzej Halicki - § 22 - Am 64
title: REPORT on general guidelines for the preparation of the 2026 budget, Section III – Commission
part_text: 22. Calls on the Commission to increase EU funding for protecting citizens of all religions and public spaces against terrorist threats, combating radicalisation and terrorist content online, as well as countering hate speech and rising antisemitism, anti-Christian hatred, anti-Muslim hatred and racism;
